name: WD 2TB Elements Portable External Hard Drive - USB 3.0
description: USB 3.0 portable hard drive for Windows PCs. Fast data transfers, high capacity, plug-and-play setup. Formatted NTFS, compatible with Windows 10, 8.1, and 7.

name: SanDisk SSD PLUS 1TB Internal SSD - SATA III 6 Gb/s
description: Internal solid state drive for desktop and laptop upgrades. Read/write speeds up to 535MB/s and 450MB/s. Ideal for faster boot times, application load, and everyday PC performance.

name: Silicon Power 256GB SSD 3D NAND A55 SLC Cache SATA III 2.5-inch
description: Budget-friendly 2.5-inch SSD with 3D NAND flash for reliable performance. 7mm slim design fits Ultrabooks and thin laptops. Supports TRIM, Garbage Collection, and ECC for longevity.

name: WD 4TB Gaming Drive for PlayStation 4 Portable External Hard Drive
description: Expand PS4 storage with 4TB of portable capacity. Plug-and-play setup, no external power required. Compact design with a 3-year limited warranty.

name: Acer SB220Q 21.5-inch Full HD IPS Monitor
description: 21.5-inch Full HD (1920x1080) IPS monitor with AMD Radeon FreeSync. Zero-frame ultra-thin design, 4ms response time, 75Hz refresh rate, 178-degree viewing angles. Great as a desktop monitor or second screen.

name: Samsung 49-inch CHG90 144Hz Curved Gaming Monitor - Super Ultrawide QLED
description: 49-inch Super Ultrawide 32:9 curved gaming monitor with Quantum Dot (QLED) display and HDR support. 144Hz refresh rate and 1ms response time. Ideal for immersive gaming and multi-window productivity.

name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Noise-Canceling Headphones
description: Industry-leading noise cancellation with 8 microphones and Auto NC Optimizer. 30-hour battery life, multipoint Bluetooth connection, Speak-to-Chat feature. Foldable design with premium carrying case. Perfect for travel, commuting, and focus work.

name: Apple AirPods Pro 2nd Generation with MagSafe Case
description: Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency mode. Adaptive Audio adjusts between modes automatically. Up to 6 hours listening time, 30 hours total with case. IPX4 water resistance. Works seamlessly with iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

name: Logitech MX Master 3S Wireless Performance Mouse
description: 8K DPI optical sensor works on any surface including glass. MagSpeed electromagnetic scroll wheel for fast and precise scrolling. Connects via Bluetooth or USB receiver to up to 3 devices. Ergonomic right-handed design for all-day comfort.

name: Keychron K2 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard - Compact 75% Layout
description: Compact 75% layout mechanical keyboard with Bluetooth 5.1 and USB-C wired mode. Compatible with Mac and Windows. Available with Gateron Red, Brown, or Blue switches. White LED backlight, aluminum frame, hot-swappable version available.

name: Anker 65W USB-C Compact Charging Brick - GaN II Technology
description: 65W GaN II fast charger in a compact form factor. Charges a MacBook Pro, iPad, or Android phone at full speed. Single USB-C port with PowerIQ 3.0. Compatible with all USB-C devices. Foldable prongs for travel.

name: Anker 26800mAh Portable Charger - Dual USB-A Output
description: High-capacity 26800mAh power bank charges an iPhone up to 6.5 times or a Samsung Galaxy up to 4 times. Dual USB-A ports for simultaneous charging. MultiProtect safety system prevents overcharging. LED indicator shows remaining power.

name: Logitech C920 HD Pro Webcam - 1080p 30fps
description: Full HD 1080p video at 30fps with stereo audio from two built-in microphones. Automatic light correction and HD autofocus. Compatible with Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet. Universal clip fits laptops, monitors, and tripods.

name: Amazon Echo Dot 5th Generation Smart Speaker with Alexa
description: Compact smart speaker with improved audio and a built-in temperature sensor. Control smart home devices, set alarms, play music, and get answers with Alexa. Ecolink connection for lower energy use. Available in Charcoal, Glacier White, and Deep Sea Blue.

name: Apple iPad 10th Generation 64GB Wi-Fi - 10.9-inch
description: 10.9-inch Liquid Retina display with True Tone. A14 Bionic chip for fast performance and gaming. 12MP front and rear cameras. USB-C connector, Wi-Fi 6 support, all-day battery life. Compatible with Apple Pencil and Magic Keyboard Folio.

name: Kindle Paperwhite 16GB E-reader - 6.8-inch Glare-Free Display
description: 300 ppi glare-free Paperwhite display, readable in bright sunlight. Adjustable warm light and auto-adjusting brightness. IPX8 waterproof, up to 10 weeks battery life. Stores thousands of books. Available with or without ads on the lock screen.

name: Nintendo Switch OLED Model - White
description: 7-inch OLED screen with vivid colors and crisp contrast. Enhanced audio from built-in speakers. 64GB internal storage, wide adjustable stand, and wired LAN port in dock. Play at home on TV or on the go in handheld mode.

name: Canon EOS M50 Mark II Mirrorless Camera - 24.1MP with 15-45mm Lens Kit
description: 24.1MP APS-C CMOS sensor with DIGIC 8 processor. 4K video recording, Dual Pixel CMOS autofocus with eye detection. Flip-out touchscreen, built-in Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Lightweight body at 387g. Great for content creators, vloggers, and photography beginners.
